svg.title: Two processes, three mappings, two Shared Data Payloads
svg.desc: All seven depicted metadata objects are separate Kernel Heap payloads. PCB 1 links Shared Memory Attachment 1 then 2, referencing Shared Memory Entry 1 then 2. PCB 2 links Shared Memory Attachment 3, also referencing Entry 1. Entry 1 has reference_count 2 and Entry 2 has reference_count 1. Entries are linked by next from the independent global shared_memory_list_head in kernel .data. address reaches each corresponding Shared Data Payload.

g.text: Two processes, three mappings, two Shared Data Payloads
Low to high addresses → · Widths are illustrative
Yellow: block headers · Blue: allocated payloads · Green: free payloads
